summary_for_children: Surah Maryam tells of Zakariyya's prayer for a child, of Maryam and the birth of Isa, of Ibrahim speaking gently to his father, and of other prophets.
environment_concept: A sanctuary of prayer, a distant place with a palm tree and a stream, and a mount where Musa was called.
architecture_and_scenery: Prayer chamber, lonely valley with one tall palm and a stream, family home, and a mountain slope.

areas.name: Prayer Chamber
areas.description: A quiet chamber; no one shown.

areas.name: The Palm Tree
areas.description: A tall palm in a remote place.

areas.name: The Mount
areas.description: A mountain slope where Musa was called.

activities.name: Gentle words
activities.description: Choose the gentle way Ibrahim spoke to his father, read from the ayahs.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: The palm and the stream
activities.description: Find the stream and the dates (an adaptation; Maryam is not shown or played).
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

narration_plan: Narration is quiet and reverent; Maryam, Isa and all prophets are never shown or voiced.
learning_objectives: Retell Maryam's account from the ayahs

status.playable_environment: not built: a shared symbolic setting stands in

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.
